source.author: verg
source.text: Venit summa dies et ineluctabile tempus Dardaniae: fuimus Troes, fuit Ilium et ingens gloria Teucrorum; ferus omnia Iuppiter Argos transtulit; incensa Danai dominantur in urbe.
source.text_original: 'Venit summa dies et ineluctabile tempus / Dardaniae: fuimus Troes, fuit Ilium et ingens / gloria Teucrorum; ferus omnia Iuppiter Argos / transtulit; incensa Danai dominantur in urbe.
source.text_english: The last day and the unavoidable time have come for Dardanian Troy: we were Trojans; Ilium was, and the great glory of the Teucrians; savage Jupiter has transferred all things to Argos; the Danaans, having burned the city, hold dominion in it.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: accelerat sed summa dies Asiamque labantem linquimus et poscunt iam me sua tempora Grai.
reuse.text_original: accelerat sed summa dies Asiamque labantem / linquimus et poscunt iam me sua tempora Grai.
reuse.text_english: He hastens on, but the last day is near, and we leave Asia in its decline, and now the Greeks claim their own time from me.
